body:
## Problem
When the merge source lacks some dataset columns, `create_plan` fills every missing column from the target side of the join, which pulls all of them into the target scan. Only an update writes back an existing row, yet a delete by key (a key-only source with `when_matched_delete`), an insert-only merge with a partial source, and a key-only `when_not_matched_by_source_delete` all read the whole table. On a 1M-row, 6-column table, deleting 1000 keys reads 150 MB, while the same delete with a full-schema source reads 2.4 MB.

## Fix
The missing columns are filled from the target only when `when_matched` updates. Otherwise they are filled with a typed NULL that carries the target column's metadata, since every row written is then an insert whose target side is already NULL. The one exception is a deferred `DeleteIf`: `MergeConditionExec` evaluates it over the filled columns, so the columns it references are still read from the target.

## Effect
Bytes read from the target, measured on a 1M-row table with 6 columns (int64 key, int32, float64, string, 32-dim float32 vector, struct; about 144 MB on local disk), with no scalar index on the key:

| Merge | Source columns | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delete matched rows by key | key | 150 MB | 2.4 MB |
| Insert only, matched rows untouched | key, k | 149 MB | 2.4 MB |
| Delete matched rows + insert | key, k | 149 MB | 2.4 MB |
| Fail on match + insert | key, k | 149 MB | 2.4 MB |
| Delete rows not matched by source | key | 150 MB | 2.4 MB |
| Delete matched + `DeleteIf(k < 5)` not matched by source | key | 150 MB | 3.7 MB |
| Insert + `DeleteIf(f < 0.01)` not matched by source | key, k | 149 MB | 10.2 MB |
| Partial-schema upsert (updates, unchanged) | key, k | 149 MB | 149 MB |

The resulting tables are identical before and after in every case, and merges that take the scalar-index path are unaffected. Two regression tests cover the key-only delete projection and the `DeleteIf` exception.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

No merge-blocking issues found. Local tests verified column pruning, conditional-delete results, and inserts with omitted nested, vector, and JSON columns.
